trips.name: Luxor
trips.about: Home to Karnak and Luxor Temples on the banks of the Nile — one of the richest ancient sites in the world.

trips.name: Aswan
trips.about: A calm Nile city with Philae Temple, felucca rides and Nubian culture.

trips.name: Siwa
trips.about: A remote oasis in the Western Desert with palm groves, salt lakes and the old Shali fortress.

trips.name: Giza & Cairo
trips.about: See the Great Pyramids and the Sphinx, then explore Cairo's museums and old streets.

trips.name: Alexandria
trips.about: Egypt's Mediterranean city: the Qaitbay Citadel, the seafront Corniche and fresh seafood.

trips.name: Hurghada
trips.about: A Red Sea resort city known for coral reefs, diving, snorkeling and island boat trips.

trips.name: Sharm El Sheikh
trips.about: A Sinai resort town with Naama Bay, Ras Mohammed National Park and world-class diving.

video.title: Discover Egypt
video.text: Temples on the Nile, desert oases and Red Sea reefs — plan your next journey through the land of the pharaohs.

stories.title: Walk Through the Temples of Luxor
stories.text: Start at Karnak, wander along the sphinx avenue and end the day at Luxor Temple as the lights come on.

stories.title: Drift Down the Nile to Philae
stories.text: Hop on a felucca in Aswan and sail out to the island temple of Isis at Philae.

stories.title: Sleep Under the Stars in Siwa
stories.text: Float in a salt lake, explore the old Shali fortress and watch the sun set behind the palms.

stories.title: Meet the Pyramids at Giza
stories.text: Stand in front of the Great Pyramid and the Sphinx, then spend an evening in Cairo's old streets.

stories.title: Snorkel the Reefs Off Hurghada
stories.text: Take a boat to the Red Sea islands, swim over the coral and relax on the sand.

stories.title: A Day by the Sea in Alexandria
stories.text: Visit the Qaitbay Citadel, stroll along the Corniche and finish with fresh seafood.

events.title: Nile Eco Days
events.description: Explore ideas and activities that celebrate the Nile and sustainable travel.

events.title: Cairo Culture Week
events.description: A celebration of local art, music, crafts and Egyptian culture.

events.title: Siwa Heritage Festival
events.description: Discover oasis traditions, local crafts and the landscapes of Siwa.

places.name: Nile View Café
places.description: Relax with a Nile view and a comfortable atmosphere.
places.details: Enjoy a calm corner above the river with specialty coffee, fresh juices and homemade desserts. It is a good stop between sightseeing days, with air-conditioned indoor seating and a breezy terrace. Come around sunset for the best light over the water.
info: Best for: Coffee, desserts and Nile views
Average spend: about EGP 180 per person
Good to know: Reservations recommended on weekends

places.name: Alexandria Seaside Café
places.description: A casual seaside stop for coffee, desserts and sunset views.
places.details: A relaxed seaside café for coffee, ice cream and sweets with the Mediterranean in front of you. Ideal for a slow afternoon after visiting the Citadel or walking the Corniche; it gets lively in the evening.
info: Average spend: about EGP 220 per person
Good to know: Windy evenings — bring a light jacket

places.name: Desert Safari Adventure
places.description: A fun desert experience with sightseeing and outdoor activities.
places.details: A guided drive through the desert dunes with photo stops, a short camel ride and a sunset tea break. Suitable for most ages; hotel pick-up can be arranged.
info: Includes: Transport and a local guide
Bring: Sun protection, water and a light scarf
Good to know: Wear closed shoes
Booking: Confirm the pick-up point on WhatsApp

places.name: Nile Felucca Ride
places.description: Enjoy a calm traditional boat ride along the Nile.
places.details: Glide along the Nile on a traditional sailing boat with a local captain. Quiet, scenic and great for photos; you can stop near the islands and enjoy a cold drink on board.
info: Price: from EGP 500 per boat ride
Suitable for: Couples, families and small groups
Good to know: Weather and wind can change the route
Booking: Confirm the departure point on WhatsApp

places.name: Family Fun Day
places.description: A flexible entertainment option for families and groups.
places.details: A flexible day of entertainment for families and groups, planned around ages and interests — games, light activities and relaxed breaks. Tell us your group size and we will suggest a plan.
info: Good to know: Child-friendly options available
Booking: Share group size and ages on WhatsApp

places.name: Red Sea Boat Day
places.description: A full day of sea views, relaxation and water activities.
places.details: A full day on the Red Sea with boat rides, swimming and snorkeling stops, plus time to relax on deck. Snorkeling gear and a light lunch are part of a typical day.
info: Includes: Boat trip and swimming stops
Bring: Swimwear, towel and sun cream
Good to know: Sea conditions can affect the schedule
Booking: Confirm the departure time on WhatsApp
